name: job-hunt
description: Right-side dock panel for a job search folder (one with resume.txt): resume variants, application funnel with a silence flag, jobs ranked by resume fit in two groups (relocate and remote); the applied, tailor and search buttons queue a Claude turn; /hunt opens it by hand; p or /hunt anon swaps in demo data for screenshots.

target.title: Which jobs to look for
target.description: search target for s: search and /hunt scan, one line
target.default: roles that match the resume: abroad with visa sponsorship or relocation, or fully remote from my country

exclude.title: Which jobs to skip
exclude.description: kinds of jobs the search leaves out, one line, e.g. staff/lead roles, frontend, internships

facts.title: Verified facts file
facts.description: file in the resume folder with facts about you beyond the resume; search and tailoring use only these facts
